findings.explanation: Ownership of your work passes to the client as it is created, before you have been paid.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Work Product shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for the Services.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have one quick adjustment to suggest before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause about work product, ownership currently passes before payment is received. I propose updating this section to state that Ownership of the Work Product shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for the Services. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
